name: 方正小篆体 (FZXiaoZhuanTi-S13T)
measurement_scope: 292 selected modern characters requested from third-party public JPEG preview; 257 yielded measurable ink and 35 yielded no ink. This is raster measurement, not vendor font metrics. No font outlines or font software acquired or copied. Approximate +/-1pixel raster/threshold uncertainty. Font identity is declared by preview provider and visually corroborated against supplied screenshot, not independently validated from font name table. Most traditional encoded counterparts yielded no ink; simplified encoded counterparts were measured where present. Missing characters are excluded from calibration.
findings: Ordinary full character bodies generally share37-40px height, with narrow widths varying by shape.
Horizontal number primitives retain intentionally low heights:1=4px,2=22px,3=27px; their widths20-22px remain similar.
A few simple enclosures are shorter:口30,日33,田32,目33px.
Do not force one universal box or apply one arbitrary standalone reduction; use common body heights with optical reductions for known sparse forms.
